    Proposition 10.1(1): the Hom modules of E₄ are free, and E₄/2E₄ = C⁽²⁾ #

    integral-deformations.tex (prop:fixed-integral-companion(1)): "Its Hom modules are free over 𝒪, and E₄/2E₄ = C⁽²⁾." Here E₄ is the graded Hom category of the lifts M̃_i of the modules M_i of C⁽²⁾ (ModLift).

    For lifts M̃ → M, Ñ → N (IsLift) and a degree d, let H̃_d be the graded Λ̃-module maps M̃ → Ñ of degree d and H_d the graded Λ-module maps M → N of degree d. Reduction H̃_d → H_d (redHom) is surjective when Ext¹_d(M, N) = 0 (exists_liftHom), its kernel is 2H̃_d (ker_redHom), and 2f = 0 forces red f = 0 (redHom_of_two). A finite ℤ/4-module with such a reduction onto an 𝔽₂-space is free on lifts of a basis (free_of_red). So H̃_d is free with H̃_d/2H̃_d = H_d (homFree).

            Proposition 10.1(1) (prop:fixed-integral-companion(1)): the graded Hom modules of E₄ (the lifts M̃_X of the modules of C⁽²⁾) are free over 𝒪 = ℤ/4 in every degree d > −2, and reduction identifies E₄/2E₄ with the graded Hom spaces of the modules of C⁽²⁾, which are those of C⁽²⁾ by the evaluation of Proposition 2.10.
